verdict.rationale: Bolna ships two first-party natural-language capabilities. Agent Studio turns a short plain-language description of a use case into a call-ready voice agent. An official MCP server lets AI assistants such as Claude or Cursor connect to and act on a Bolna account. However, the natural-language path is documented only for agent creation, and the MCP tool scope is not described, so broad operation of the product by natural-language command is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface covering general operations (calls, numbers, batches), documented MCP tool coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Agent Studio turns a short description of your use case into a production-grade, call-ready voice AI agent — in 5 to 8 minutes.
Connect Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client to your Bolna account with the Bolna MCP server.
The Bolna MCP server connects your AI assistant directly to your Bolna account over the Model Context Protocol
